"""Generate a photographic-style, directly painted pixel-space microgravity shot.
All surfaces, distortion and animation are image-space operations; no renderer.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SPEC = json.loads((ROOT/'task_spec.json').read_text())
W,H,S = SPEC['width'],SPEC['height'],3
SW,SH = W*S,H*S
rng = np.random.default_rng(9147)


def ellipse(d,b,fill,outline=None,width=1):
    d.ellipse(tuple(v*S for v in b),fill=fill,outline=outline,width=max(1,int(width*S)))
def poly(d,p,fill):
    d.polygon([(int(x*S),int(y*S)) for x,y in p],fill=fill)
def line(d,p,fill,width=1):
    d.line([(int(x*S),int(y*S)) for x,y in p],fill=fill,width=max(1,int(width*S)),joint='curve')
def rect(d,b,fill,outline=None,width=1,radius=0):
    b=tuple(int(v*S) for v in b)
    if radius: d.rounded_rectangle(b,radius=int(radius*S),fill=fill,outline=outline,width=max(1,int(width*S)))
    else: d.rectangle(b,fill=fill,outline=outline,width=max(1,int(width*S)))

def backdrop():
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:SH,:SW].astype(float); x=xx/S; y=yy/S
    lit=16*np.exp(-((x-90)/160)**2-((y-15)/100)**2)-0.12*y
    a=np.stack([168+lit,177+lit,181+lit],axis=-1)
    a+=rng.normal(0,1.25,(SH,SW,1))
    im=Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(a,0,255)))
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    # Converging seams and shallow equipment bays in the station's module.
    poly(d,[(0,0),(178,0),(152,39),(0,50)],(207,211,211))
    poly(d,[(0,49),(150,38),(155,139),(0,144)],(155,165,170))
    poly(d,[(156,0),(256,0),(256,144),(155,144),(146,42)],(186,193,194))
    line(d,[(2,51),(146,40),(156,144)],(80,96,103),3)
    line(d,[(0,48),(148,37),(157,144)],(224,228,223),1.2)
    line(d,[(155,0),(145,36)],(95,108,115),2)
    # overhead fluorescent diffuser, soft reflection in the polished cup
    poly(d,[(21,0),(125,0),(112,10),(8,18)],(126,142,145))
    poly(d,[(24,0),(120,0),(109,7),(12,14)],(247,249,236))
    line(d,[(12,16),(109,9)],(231,241,234),2)
    for i in range(3):
        line(d,[(2,24+i*5),(128,14+i*5)],(178+i*4,183+i*4,183+i*4),0.7)
    # soft fabric cargo bags with webbing and buckles
    for bx,by,bw,bh in [(9,28,46,34),(62,21,50,31),(114,16,27,24)]:
        rect(d,(bx+1,by+2,bx+bw+2,by+bh+3),(98,110,114),radius=4)
        rect(d,(bx,by,bx+bw,by+bh),(201,205,194),outline=(176,181,173),radius=4)
        for k in range(4):
            line(d,[(bx+3,by+3+k),(bx+bw-6,by+2+k)],(220-k*4,222-k*4,212-k*4),0.5)
        line(d,[(bx+7,by+2),(bx+6,by+bh-3)],(177,181,169),1)
        line(d,[(bx+bw-7,by+4),(bx+bw-6,by+bh-2)],(154,165,156),2.5)
        line(d,[(bx+2,by+bh*.6),(bx+bw-2,by+bh*.6)],(161,168,156),2.1)
        rect(d,(bx+bw*.48,by+bh*.6-3,bx+bw*.48+7,by+bh*.6+3),(102,112,106),radius=1)
        rect(d,(bx+10,by+8,bx+27,by+15),(233,233,219))
        for j in range(3): line(d,[(bx+12,by+10+j*1.5),(bx+24-j*2,by+10+j*1.5)],(107,114,109),.45)
    # rear equipment rack: black displays, vents, service fasteners
    rect(d,(4,68,63,141),(106,122,129),outline=(58,77,87),radius=2)
    rect(d,(8,72,59,112),(187,193,190),outline=(213,216,208),width=.8)
    rect(d,(12,77,46,100),(39,54,65),radius=1)
    rect(d,(14,79,44,97),(26,46,57),radius=.6)
    for k in range(6):
        line(d,[(17,82+k*2),(31+(k%3)*3,82+k*2)],(87,135,138),.5)
    for k in range(3): ellipse(d,(51,80+k*7,54,83+k*7),(76,88,88))
    ellipse(d,(51,80,53,82),(108,199,154))
    for k in range(8): line(d,[(12,117+k*2),(53,117+k*2)],(66,85,94),.7)
    # white locker on the far wall
    rect(d,(71,57,142,141),(190,198,197),outline=(120,136,140),width=1.2,radius=2)
    rect(d,(77,63,135,130),(208,213,207),outline=(157,173,174),radius=1)
    line(d,[(79,64),(79,126),(132,126)],(229,232,221),1)
    rect(d,(127,84,132,104),(92,111,117),radius=1)
    rect(d,(128,86,130,101),(181,194,193),radius=.4)
    rect(d,(86,70,107,77),(223,224,213))
    for j in range(3): line(d,[(89,72+j*1.4),(103-j*3,72+j*1.4)],(112,128,127),.45)
    # distinctive round observation window; Earth is seen through a heavy rim.
    ellipse(d,(170,14,260,105),(102,116,122))
    ellipse(d,(174,16,256,102),(204,210,207))
    ellipse(d,(178,20,252,98),(57,70,79))
    ellipse(d,(182,24,248,94),(12,22,35))
    win=Image.new('RGB',(SW,SH)); wd=ImageDraw.Draw(win)
    wd.rectangle((0,0,SW,SH),fill=(8,17,30))
    ellipse(wd,(174,52,282,166),(27,68,96))
    ellipse(wd,(174,51,282,165),(89,157,188),outline=(132,197,218),width=1)
    ellipse(wd,(179,55,283,168),(43,105,147))
    # streaks of cloud curvature, with subpixel edges
    for i in range(32):
        y=64+i*2.1; x=182+8*np.sin(i*.54)
        line(wd,[(x,y),(x+10,y-2),(x+24,y+1),(x+32,y-1)],(153+i%4*12,185+i%3*13,195+i%3*13),.6+(i%3)*.25)
    wm=Image.new('L',(SW,SH)); ellipse(ImageDraw.Draw(wm),(183,25,247,93),255)
    im.paste(win,(0,0),wm)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    for ang in np.arange(0,360,45):
        x=215+39*np.cos(np.radians(ang));y=59+40*np.sin(np.radians(ang))
        ellipse(d,(x-1.4,y-1.4,x+1.4,y+1.4),(85,98,101))
        line(d,[(x-.6,y),(x+.6,y)],(180,188,183),.45)
    # visible station cabling and padded vertical hand rail
    line(d,[(158,3),(161,30),(163,69),(159,112),(164,144)],(62,80,91),3)
    line(d,[(157,3),(159,30),(161,69),(157,112),(162,144)],(164,177,183),1)
    line(d,[(248,109),(213,113),(195,139)],(74,91,101),3)
    line(d,[(248,108),(213,112),(195,138)],(214,220,208),1.5)
    for x,y in [(68,62),(137,62),(137,134),(70,135),(7,72),(59,111)]:
        ellipse(d,(x-.9,y-.9,x+.9,y+.9),(89,108,111))
        line(d,[(x-.4,y),(x+.4,y)],(218,224,214),.3)
    # photographic background is out of focus; foreground remains sharp
    im=im.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.62*S))
    aa=np.asarray(im).astype(float)
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:SH,:SW]
    exposure=1+.05*np.exp(-((xx/S-83)/130)**2-((yy/S-20)/80)**2)
    aa=aa*exposure[...,None]
    return np.clip(aa,0,255).astype(np.uint8)

PW,PH=180*S,180*S
OX,OY=90,85
py,px=np.mgrid[:PH,:PW]; LX=px/S-OX; LY=py/S-OY

def shape_mask(points=None,ell=None):
    m=Image.new('L',(PW,PH));d=ImageDraw.Draw(m)
    if points:
        d.polygon([((x+OX)*S,(y+OY)*S) for x,y in points],fill=255)
    if ell:
        d.ellipse(tuple((v+(OX if i%2==0 else OY))*S for i,v in enumerate(ell)),fill=255)
    return m

def skin_surface(im,mask,center,radii,shade=0):
    cx,cy=center;rx,ry=radii
    r=((LX-cx)/rx)**2+((LY-cy)/ry)**2
    light=14*np.exp(-r*1.2)-10*np.clip((LX-cx)/rx,0,1)-9*np.clip((LY-cy)/ry,0,1)
    grain=rng.normal(0,.75,(PH,PW))
    aa=np.stack([186+light+shade+grain,130+light*.8+shade+grain,99+light*.65+shade+grain],-1)
    im.paste(Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(aa,0,255))),(0,0),mask)

def make_cup():
    im=Image.new('RGBA',(PW,PH))
    # palm behind the cylinder
    palm=shape_mask(points=[(-48,43),(-47,20),(-39,1),(-28,-4),(-14,4),(4,19),(3,35),(-14,54),(-34,60)])
    skin_surface(im,palm,(-30,24),(27,34),-3)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    def l(p,c,w=1): line(d,[(x+OX,y+OY) for x,y in p],c,w)
    l([(-40,28),(-36,38),(-24,43)],(152,100,77,110),.55)
    # metal tumbler: broad reflected light bands and faint brushed machining
    body=shape_mask(points=[(-22,-33),(22,-33),(20,28),(17,33),(9,35),(-10,35),(-18,32),(-21,26)])
    xx=LX
    shade=(116+55*np.exp(-((xx+12)/8)**2)+73*np.exp(-((xx+19)/1.8)**2)
           -65*np.exp(-((xx-9)/5)**2)+44*np.exp(-((xx-18)/2.1)**2))
    shade+=4*np.sin(xx*2.7)+2*np.sin(xx*12.1)
    shade+=5*np.exp(-((LY+15)/25)**2)-12*np.clip((LY-19)/17,0,1)
    texture=rng.normal(0,.55,(PH,PW))+1.3*np.sin(LY*7.4+np.sin(xx*.3))
    steel=np.stack([shade*.93+texture,shade*1.025+texture,shade*1.09+texture],-1)
    im.paste(Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(steel,0,255))),(0,0),body)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    l([(-21,-27),(-20,24),(-18,29)],(217,223,219,255),.7)
    l([(21,-25),(19,27),(16,31)],(63,76,82,255),.75)
    # subtle rolled foot
    l([(-17,31),(-10,34),(8,34),(17,31)],(78,92,100,255),1)
    l([(-16,32),(-9,33),(8,33),(15,31)],(170,182,184,255),.4)
    # rim, cavity and the water surface inside the cup
    ellipse(d,((OX-23),(OY-42),(OX+23),(OY-24)),(209,218,216,255))
    ellipse(d,((OX-21.4),(OY-40.3),(OX+21.4),(OY-26)),(45,65,76,255))
    ellipse(d,((OX-19.7),(OY-38.6),(OX+19.7),(OY-26.8)),(91,122,138,255))
    # thin meniscus reflects the cabin light
    d.arc(tuple(v*S for v in (OX-20,OY-39,OX+20,OY-26)),15,168,fill=(165,194,201,255),width=2)
    d.arc(tuple(v*S for v in (OX-23,OY-42,OX+23,OY-24)),5,165,fill=(239,241,225,255),width=3)
    l([(-12,-34),(-6,-36),(8,-36),(15,-33)],(161,186,190,255),.65)
    l([(-15,-32),(-7,-33),(0,-32)],(210,225,218,255),.5)
    # gripping fingertips placed over the front: shaded, not outlined
    for b,c,r,sh in [((-32,13,3,26),(-16,18),(18,7),0),((-33,25,-3,37),(-19,29),(16,7),-3),((-35,35,-11,45),(-24,39),(13,6),-7)]:
        mask=shape_mask(ell=b);skin_surface(im,mask,c,r,sh)
        dd=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
        x0,y0,x1,y1=b
        dd.arc(tuple((v+(OX if k%2==0 else OY))*S for k,v in enumerate((x0+4,y0+3,x1-4,y1))),8,73,fill=(136,90,71,110),width=1)
    thumb=shape_mask(points=[(-39,12),(-36,0),(-30,-8),(-24,-9),(-17,-3),(-14,6),(-8,16),(-13,20),(-23,17),(-31,9)])
    thumb=thumb.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.35*S))
    skin_surface(im,thumb,(-27,1),(14,21),5)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    # warm pale thumbnail following the thumb's diagonal
    poly(d,[(OX-29,OY-7),(OX-24,OY-7),(OX-19,OY-1),(OX-20,OY+3),(OX-25,OY+2),(OX-30,OY-3)],(206,163,139,255))
    l([(-29,-6),(-25,-6),(-20,0)],(227,188,164,255),.6)
    l([(-29,9),(-25,12),(-22,12)],(145,96,76,170),.55)
    # Very small steel inspection marking, not a large visual label.
    l([(4,3),(11,3)],(75,89,94,120),.4)
    l([(5,5),(9,5)],(75,89,94,100),.4)
    return im

BG=backdrop(); CUP=make_cup()
Y,X=np.mgrid[:SH,:SW].astype(float); X/=S;Y/=S

def transform(x,y,theta,cx=80,cy=91):
    a=math.radians(theta)
    return cx+x*math.cos(a)-y*math.sin(a), cy+x*math.sin(a)+y*math.cos(a)

def angle(f):
    return 13+51*(1-math.exp(-f/5.7))

def foreground(f):
    theta=angle(f)
    im=Image.fromarray(BG).convert('RGBA')
    # sleeve and exposed wrist connect to the smoothly rotating hand
    wx,wy=transform(-32,47,theta)
    arm=Image.new('RGBA',(SW,SH));d=ImageDraw.Draw(arm)
    poly(d,[(-16,146),(14,147),(wx+10,wy+9),(wx-13,wy-7)],(153,103,80,255))
    poly(d,[(-12,143),(5,148),(wx+6,wy+8),(wx-4,wy+1)],(192,140,108,255))
    line(d,[(4,143),(wx+3,wy+8)],(208,153,117,255),3)
    poly(d,[(-15,121),(9,130),(21,144),(-11,160)],(81,109,137,255))
    poly(d,[(-14,125),(7,132),(17,146),(-8,153)],(112,143,169,255))
    line(d,[(-7,126),(6,133),(15,145)],(158,181,197,255),1.3)
    for k in range(5): line(d,[(-9+k*2.5,131),(3+k*2.5,148)],(87,119,145,255),.5)
    im=Image.alpha_composite(im,arm)
    rot=CUP.rotate(-theta,resample=Image.Resampling.BICUBIC,center=(OX*S,OY*S))
    im.alpha_composite(rot,(round((80-OX)*S),round((91-OY)*S)))
    return np.asarray(im.convert('RGB')).astype(float)


def smoothunion(a,b,k):
    h=np.clip(.5+.5*(a-b)/k,0,1)
    return b*(1-h)+a*h+k*h*(1-h)

def water_blob(im,parts,scale=10):
    # A screen-space implicit silhouette. Refraction samples the already painted
    # RGB image; the highlights and edge Fresnel effects are pixel operations.
    field=np.full((SH,SW),-1e4)
    for cx,cy,rx,ry in parts:
        dd=(1-np.sqrt(((X-cx)/rx)**2+((Y-cy)/ry)**2))*min(rx,ry)
        field=smoothunion(field,dd,min(2.0,ry*.65))
    alpha=np.clip(field*S+.5,0,1)
    if not np.any(alpha):return im
    gy,gx=np.gradient(field,1/S,1/S)
    ln=np.sqrt(gx*gx+gy*gy)+1e-6
    radial=np.clip(1-field/scale,0,1)
    nx=-gx/ln*radial;ny=-gy/ln*radial
    nz=np.sqrt(np.maximum(0,1-nx*nx-ny*ny))
    # spherical liquid lens reverses distant cabin detail near its edges
    ux=np.clip(((X+nx*(3.1+4*nz))*S).astype(int),0,SW-1)
    uy=np.clip(((Y+ny*(3.1+4*nz))*S).astype(int),0,SH-1)
    refr=im[uy,ux].copy()
    tint=np.array([58,100,119])
    refr=.88*refr+.12*tint
    # subtle dark inner rim and illuminated silhouette
    edge=np.exp(-((field-.6)/.72)**2)
    fresnel=radial**7
    refr*=1-.26*fresnel[...,None]
    lighting=np.clip(-nx*.64-ny*.62,0,1)
    refr+=edge[...,None]*(lighting[...,None]*np.array([131,151,151]) + np.array([14,24,29]))
    # softbox reflection and compact specular glint on the curved surface
    spec=np.maximum(0,-nx*.43-ny*.57+nz*.70)**42
    refl=np.exp(-((nx+.34)/.095)**2)*np.exp(-((ny+.57)/.35)**2)
    refr+=spec[...,None]*np.array([152,155,143])+refl[...,None]*np.array([46,51,48])
    # low-contrast reflected dark equipment, important for clear water visibility
    band=np.exp(-((ny-.49)/.095)**2)*np.maximum(0,nz)
    refr-=band[...,None]*np.array([20,23,23])
    return im*(1-alpha[...,None])+np.clip(refr,0,255)*alpha[...,None]

def liquid(f,im):
    if f<2:return im
    th=angle(f)
    lip=np.array(transform(21,-32,th))
    # first released body grows outwards, pinches free, and drifts rather than falls
    a=f-2
    if a<=7:
        cx=lip[0]+2+4.7*a;cy=lip[1]-1-.70*a
        rx=2.6+min(a,6)*1.9;ry=2.2+min(a,6)*1.45
    else:
        old=np.array(transform(21,-32,angle(9)))
        cx=old[0]+34.9+(a-7)*3.65;cy=old[1]-5.9-(a-7)*1.52
        rx=15.2+.6*math.sin(a*.7);ry=12+.4*math.sin(a*.7+.4)
    parts=[(cx,cy,rx,ry),(cx+rx*.38,cy-ry*.35,rx*.58,ry*.66)]
    if a<=6:
        for j in range(8):
            q=j/8
            xx=lip[0]+(cx-lip[0])*q; yy=lip[1]+(cy-lip[1])*q
            rr=(2.3+.9*math.sin(q*math.pi))*(1 if a<5 else .7)
            parts.append((xx,yy,rr+1.0,rr))
    elif a==7:
        parts.append((cx-rx-1.8,cy+1,3,2))
    im=water_blob(im,parts,max(3,ry))
    # second, smaller volume of water released into the same weightless region
    if f>=9:
        b=f-9
        if b<=5:
            bx=lip[0]+3+4.5*b;by=lip[1]+2+.36*b
            brx=2.6+1.7*b;bry=2.1+1.3*b
        else:
            old=np.array(transform(21,-32,angle(14)))
            bx=old[0]+25.5+(b-5)*4.0;by=old[1]+3.8-(b-5)*.5
            brx=11.2;bry=9.0
        ps=[(bx,by,brx,bry),(bx+brx*.36,by+1,brx*.54,bry*.65)]
        if b<5:
            for j in range(6):
                q=j/6;rr=1.5+.5*np.sin(q*math.pi)
                ps.append((lip[0]+(bx-lip[0])*q,lip[1]+(by-lip[1])*q,rr+1,rr))
        im=water_blob(im,ps,bry)
    if f>=15:
        c=f-15;tx=lip[0]+2+3.8*c;ty=lip[1]+1.5+.08*c
        ps=[(tx,ty,3+1.1*c,2.4+.8*c)]
        for j in range(6):
            q=j/6;ps.append((lip[0]+(tx-lip[0])*q,lip[1]+(ty-lip[1])*q,2,1.4))
        im=water_blob(im,ps,5)
    # gently separating satellite droplets retain compact surface-tension shapes
    if f>=10:
        b=f-10
        for dx,dy,rr,vel in [(19,14,3.2,.7),(7,-20,2.1,.3),(-10,23,1.7,-.15)]:
            growth=min(1,(b+1)/3)
            sx=cx+dx+vel*b;sy=cy+dy+.13*b
            im=water_blob(im,[(sx,sy,rr*growth,rr*growth*(1+.05*np.sin(f)))],rr*growth)
    return im

frames=[]
for f in range(SPEC['frames']):
    im=liquid(f,foreground(f))
    # camera characteristics: restrained vignette, fine grain, balanced highlights
    vign=1-.105*((X-W*.49)/(W*.73))**2-.10*((Y-H*.48)/(H*.84))**2
    im*=vign[...,None]
    im+=rng.normal(0,.7,(SH,SW,1))
    img=Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(im,0,255))).resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    frames.append(np.asarray(img))
frames=np.stack(frames).astype(np.uint8)
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
print('Saved',frames.shape,'RGB video frames to',ROOT)

- Use only `prompt.txt` and `task_spec.json`. Work inside this workspace. No network, other cases, reference continuations, masks, scores, memory, external AI models, learned weights, external simulation/rendering engines, or subagents.
- Generate 20 RGB frames at 256×144, 4 fps, for 5 seconds. Generate all frames from the text.
- You must create `generate.py`, run it, and call `artifact_io.save(frames, case_dir)` at least once before finishing. Finish only after the required output artifacts exist. Keep `generate.py` runnable so it regenerates the submitted RGB video.
- Local Python/numpy/PIL, mathematical geometry, motion, lighting, copying and warping pixels are allowed.
- Construct the video directly in image/pixel space. Do not build a separate scene/world model or physics simulation and render it into video.
- Aim for live-action photographic realism for the full scene, with coherent appearance and motion.
- If you revise the video, save each revised candidate before continuing. Avoid repeated revision without a clear expected improvement; aim for high-quality output while considering efficiency.

from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }

    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))
